verdict.rationale: Aleph documents one event-driven automation of its own: mapping agents monitor source data 24/7 and act when new accounts, vendors or dimensions appear. Users steer these agents with natural-language prompts, and the agents send real-time Slack/Teams alerts for approval. Beyond that, the evidence offers only generic claims of reporting automation and putting processes 'on autopilot', with no general user-defined rule engine. missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/trigger builder for arbitrary events, configurable action types beyond mapping suggestions and alerts, documentation of rule definition and scheduling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
